recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. The current source satisfies FHIR-7152 while preserving the later FHIR-9433 clarification, so reverting to the older exact FHIR-7152 sentence would be a regression rather than a fix.
issue_request: FHIR-7152 was a Published FHIR-core Observation issue with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking to clarify Observation.issued as the date and time the observation was made available to providers, typically after review and verification, with other pre-verification timing use cases handled by extensions.
initial_application: The requested wording was historically applied in commit de360c9b20571d20454f1f559e459e873655bbb8, which changed the Observation spreadsheet definition from the older unqualified wording to the provider/review/verification wording. The commit subject was labeled #7149, so the issue key in the subject does not directly name FHIR-7152, but the patch matches the FHIR-7152 resolution. Later source-format migration preserved the wording in source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, confirming the StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. Later Published issue FHIR-9433 clarified Observation.issued and DiagnosticReport.issued; its implementation changed the definition to refer to this version of the observation and added the Meta.lastUpdated comment. No direct Confluence references or Zulip mentions of FHIR-7152 were found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit only. The combined branch already has Observation.issued defined as the date and time this version of the observation was made available to providers, typically after the results have been reviewed and verified, with a comment explaining the relationship to Meta.lastUpdated.

related_jiras.note: Published later clarification for Observation.issued and DiagnosticReport.issued; it explains the current 'this version' wording and Meta.lastUpdated comment and is already represented on the combined branch.
